Video title: Otomedori Volume One: The Rondo of Purity
Release Date: May 25, 2012

Description:
Kazuki Okino is an ordinary student. His daily life is somewhat noisy, yet it holds small moments of happiness. This is due to the presence of two women. His younger sister, Rinka. She is mischievous and causes trouble, but she adores Kazuki. And the other is his childhood friend, Otome Sakuragi.
She is a year older and tends to fuss over him. Beautiful and well-proportioned, she is the object of admiration for the boys within the academy.
Otome's fussing had become ingrained in Kazuki's life. Even without his sister pointing it out, they looked like nothing but a newlywed couple. They were mutually in love, yet neither had confessed, and they weren't officially dating. They hadn't taken that step beyond childhood friends, but Kazuki felt that if things continued as they were, they would start dating, and eventually marry.
He could simply wait for the happiness beyond him to come to him...
But that fragile happiness was shattered by a single DVD delivered to Kazuki...
